cohort: 74 patients aged 14 to 20 years who gave birth between August and November 2017 at St. Pantelimon Emergency Hospital in Bucharest, Romania.
finding: The study found a high percentage of cesarean delivery, particularly in patients aged >17 years, and a higher rate of cesarean delivery in multiparous women compared to primiparous women.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of cesarean delivery in multiparous women compared to primiparous women.
